rules.required_meaning: A terminal implement, defer or reject disposition is required before global portal completion; REQUIRED does not mean live READY.
rules.conditional_meaning: The workstream participates only when its named accepted activation trigger is proven; CONDITIONAL does not self-activate.
rules.deferred_meaning: Outside current launch scope until an accepted reactivation trigger is satisfied.

workstreams.activation_trigger: current routing drift materially prevents reliable Portal Completion selection or closeout
workstreams.boundary: current portal routing only; historical Git-ref lifecycle belongs to repository governance

workstreams.activation_trigger: a currently open implementation-authorized launch-critical or high-risk Platform repair Issue exists
workstreams.boundary: route through OTERYN_PLATFORM_REMEDIATION; historical closed findings never self-reactivate

workstreams.activation_trigger: global portal go-live completion is being claimed
workstreams.boundary: repository readiness is not production proof; direct protected-environment evidence and authority remain separate

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: runtime actions remain gated by accepted Character Authority contracts and external-repository authority

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: runtime current-state facts require an authoritative producer; unavailable evidence is never fabricated

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: source owners retain fact, freshness, publication and privacy authority

workstreams.activation_trigger: accepted launch scope includes authenticated personalization and the identity/privacy/cache gates are satisfied
workstreams.boundary: private-influenced representations remain owner-private and non-shareable

workstreams.activation_trigger: current portal completion scope
workstreams.boundary: Announcements/Events reverse-edge cleanup precedes provider onboarding

workstreams.activation_trigger: the launcher/client-distribution path is part of the accepted launch scope or an accepted live implementation handoff exists
workstreams.boundary: Platform implementation does not authorize external updater, signing infrastructure or production activation

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: content-completeness claims must remain machine-checkable

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: Platform-only work follows current repository authority; server/game evidence requires separate owner authorization

workstreams.activation_trigger: a selected slice would otherwise introduce an unresolved irreversible world/profile/ruleset/catalog/season assumption

workstreams.activation_trigger: current launch scope
workstreams.boundary: the Hunt Session Analyzer v1 satisfies the accepted first complete workflow foundation; current terminal state is resolved live, not stored here

workstreams.boundary: specialized game-auth/internal endpoints are not general PlatformAPI activation

workstreams.activation_trigger: accepted product scope explicitly promotes a read-only community surface with authoritative inputs
workstreams.boundary: product inventory inputs are not automatic launch requirements

workstreams.activation_trigger: a durable owned discussion/moderation need is accepted
workstreams.boundary: Discord plus existing Support remains the default direction

workstreams.activation_trigger: measured telemetry crosses an accepted scaling/search threshold
workstreams.boundary: derived infrastructure never becomes source truth

workstreams.activation_trigger: multiple worlds/profiles or authoritative status/history signals justify the composition
workstreams.boundary: World Hub is presentation/composition, never routing or admission authority

workstreams.activation_trigger: global portal completion requires an explicit implement, defer or reject disposition for current commerce capability findings
workstreams.boundary: REQUIRED here means terminal product disposition, not payment implementation or customer-payment activation

workstreams.activation_trigger: independent product, security, legal, provider, operational and protected-environment gates are accepted and satisfied
workstreams.boundary: production payment/value authority is separately protected
